alt: White and blue paper cards arranged on a dotted background, featuring a list of small grid icons, the text Weight and Style, a central white letter W on a blue square card, and a diagonal line of floating transparent grid patterns.
caption: A graphic design layout showing font weights, styles, and grid patterns on paper cards.
description: A stylized close-up of white and blue paper cards on a dot-grid surface. One card displays a list of interface icons next to the words Weight and Style, while a central blue card bears the letter W. A series of small, outlined squares resembling UI layout grids float along the right side of the composition in a light blue color palette.
